author: Stimulating
body:
Team Allah might disband after this TM so I figured I'd look at my options. Post down below or hmu on Skype if interested. I'd prefer at least a decent team, one with actual organization and comms, and I like teams that are a bit meme-y to have fun with. 

Positions:
Frontlines (main) 
Skybridge 
Midline (not super experienced, but I have an idea how to play) 
Defence (if I'm up to it I'm actually alright at it, just don't expect me to be up to it 24/7)

I do not play objective, I play holding frontlines. 

I can shotcall as well.
